kultivator.screen.help.aula.title: Sect Hall
kultivator.screen.help.aula: Craft a Sect Hall Stele (gold ingots, bookshelves, amethyst blocks and a lodestone) and place it to found your sect; right-click it to open the hall scroll. The hall level is the lower of renown and buildings: the stele alone allows level 2, a Book Pavilion (10 bookshelves and a lectern) level 4, your Protective Formation by the stele level 6, a Training Hall (4 target blocks) level 8 and 3 Blazing Sky Tower rooms level 9. Higher levels raise the disciple cap (5 + level/2), the territory and the number of candidates. Renown never falls and comes only from your disciples' deeds. Mining the stele makes the hall dormant; placing one again wakes it with everything kept. The stele is the Xiao clan's testing stone (Battle Through the Heavens), the hall is Yue Lu Hall (A Record of a Mortal's Journey).
kultivator.screen.help.calon.title: Recruitment Day
kultivator.screen.help.calon: Disciples now join through the hall. Every few days at sunrise, while you are near the stele, candidates come up the mountain road and wait until the next dawn. Their determination is always visible; root, soul colour, talents and physique stay hidden until the entrance test (one amethyst shard): three tiers of the climb, then the stele's Duan pillar (once the Thousand-Step Trial Stair is built, the climb becomes an illusory stair of a thousand steps and the Heart Stone records each disciple's heart; see the Living Sect topic). All three tiers: Outer Disciple. Otherwise determination 70+ still makes a Registered Disciple, as Han Li and Wang Lin entered. The rest may join on the servant path for 100 PK. An Immortal Ascension Token calls a tested candidate at once, and rare special candidates appear now and then.
kultivator.screen.help.jenjang.title: Sect Ranks
kultivator.screen.help.jenjang: The Ranks tablet is a six-storey pagoda: Registered, Outer, Inner and Core Disciple, Elder and Grand Elder. A promotion needs a realm, the disciple's own contribution points and a test (the retest, the Special Training, a tournament or Void Realm feat, a free seat, being your strongest). Higher ranks cultivate faster and may learn more techniques. Elders strengthen the meditation of disciples near them and teach juniors; the Grand Elder's aura covers the whole territory. A Dao Union disciple (or one with a star) can be appointed Sect Protector and guards the hall. Source: Renegade Immortal (grey honorary disciples), A Record of a Mortal's Journey (the half-year retest; the grand elder is the strongest), I Shall Seal the Heavens (Outer and Inner Sects, the special promotion training), Battle Through the Heavens (Outer and Inner Academy, Grand Elder Su Qian), Martial Peak (the Trial Disciple), Return of the Mount Hua Sect (generations and elders), Soul Land (the sect's protectors).
kultivator.screen.help.kontribusi.title: Contribution Points
kultivator.screen.help.kontribusi: Poin Kontribusi (PK) live in the sect treasury and on every disciple. Offer goods at the Offering Office on the Treasury tablet (up to 300 PK a day); disciples earn their own PK from slain monsters, duties, missions and events. A pill is worth half its town price in Low Spirit Stones times its quality (0.6/1/1.5/2.5; at most 300 PK); 1 PK = 2 Low Spirit Stones. Spend the treasury at the Yue Lu Pavilion (Healing 6, Qi Gathering 6, Foundation 60, Golden Core 300, Tribulation Warding 1000, Perfect Marrow Cleansing Pill 400 PK at hall level 6; invitations, sermons, technique scrolls...) or pass it to a disciple with the Sect Master's Grant. An alliance with an NPC sect gives a 10% discount at the Yue Lu Pavilion. Five different pages of one lost sect art, with a Book Pavilion built, restore the art for the whole hall.
